heading.001: SharedTrucks Logistics — Shared truckload across East Africa
heading.shared-title:
Your shipment deserves
a place on the truck.
heading.014: Tell us what you need to move
meta.001: SharedTrucks connects East Africa’s SMEs with transport providers using technology-enabled shared truckload to make local products more affordable to move.
meta.003: Shared truckload for East Africa’s makers, growers and manufacturers. More affordable freight, better truck utilization and less wasted fuel.
copy.005: East Africa’s small businesses take real risks to grow, manufacture and make goods locally. They deserve a better way to reach customers. SharedTrucks uses technology to connect their shipments with reliable transport providers and available truck space, so compatible loads can move together and share the cost.
access.003: Three separate groups of freight sharing the cargo space of a single truck
copy.007: Our shared truckload model brings compatible shipments from different businesses together along similar routes and schedules. Instead of requiring every small producer to fill an entire vehicle, we use shipment and capacity information to identify opportunities to share a journey.
copy.008: A workshop, farm or growing manufacturer can share transport costs with other compatible loads rather than carrying the expense of unused truck space.
copy.009: Transport providers can put available capacity to work on outbound and return journeys, creating earning opportunities from space that might otherwise go unused.
copy.010: Our technology brings shipment requirements, available vehicle capacity, planned routes and timing into a clearer view, helping identify practical shared truckload opportunities.
copy.011: We review cargo compatibility and coordinate with suitable transport providers. The goal is to make existing journeys work harder while giving smaller businesses a dependable route to market.
copy.020: Vehicle and route updates help us plan each shipment.
copy.021: From raw materials and farm produce to finished products, shipment size and handling needs determine the vehicle. Shared truckload is our focus when compatible goods can move together.

access.009: SharedTrucks coordinates transport between the supplier and business buyer
copy.028: Every farmer who expands production, maker who opens a workshop and entrepreneur who invests in manufacturing is betting on a stronger local economy. Reaching the next market should not depend on having enough goods to fill a whole truck.
copy.029: When fuel costs rise, pressure spreads from freight charges to business margins and the prices consumers pay. Making better use of trucks already travelling those routes can help reduce wasted capacity, unnecessary fuel use and the cost of moving locally made goods.
copy.031: Share the goods, volume, route and preferred date—even if your shipment is smaller than a full truckload.
copy.032: We assess compatible shipments, routes, timing and available vehicle space, then confirm a suitable transport option and quotation.
copy.033: We help coordinate pickup, transport and delivery with the selected provider, keeping your business informed along the way.
copy.034: Tell us what you grow, make or manufacture and where it needs to go. We will review suitable shared-load opportunities and transport availability for your route.
